summary: Skill Bank has 21 valid records across 7 categories. Schema v1.0 is solid. Directory structure is functional. Phase 2A gate requires: Kojimem integration (BLOCKED on mainnet), OpenViking evaluation (OPEN), and skill marketplace schema extension.

eval_001_openviking.relevance: ByteDance context database. Could provide skill retrieval infrastructure for Skill Bank search/recommendation.
eval_001_openviking.gate_dependency: Must complete BEFORE Phase 2A Skill Bank build begins
eval_001_openviking.action: Schedule EVAL-001 sprint when Phase 2A timeline approaches

eval_002_kojimem.relevance: x402-native wallet-scoped memory API. Recall tiers map to ClawRouter T0-T2. Delegation system for SCS memory handoff.
eval_002_kojimem.blocker: Kojimem on Base Sepolia only — mainnet launch required
eval_002_kojimem.integration_plan: 5 sprints (2A-01 to 2A-05): SDK install → Harvey memory → swarm rollout → SCS delegation → BrainX bridge

gaps_for_phase2a: No marketplace schema fields (pricing, license, rental_duration) — needed for Phase 3
No skill search/discovery mechanism — flat file listing only
OpenViking evaluation not started — may provide better retrieval
Kojimem blocked on mainnet — memory-skill bridge deferred
No skill versioning — records are immutable snapshots
Only 21 records — need 50+ for meaningful retrieval testing
recommended_next_sprints: Continue shipping sprints — crystalliseSkill auto-generates records on approval
Schema v2 — add marketplace fields when first external skill submitted
